anchors.description: Exterior length along the portable crib's front top rail between its two end corners
anchors.visible_evidence: Patterned fabric top rail with mesh sides and flared plastic corners of a portable playard seen against the window wall; the whole near top rail and both ends are visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Playard brand/model unknown; standard playards are about 40x28.5x29 in, so the long rail is 1.00-1.04 m, but a non-standard size is possible.

anchors.description: Width of the open interior door leaf between its two vertical stiles at mid-height
anchors.visible_evidence: Full-height beige interior door swung open toward the camera with latch hardware on the left stile and the bright painted latch edge on the right; both stiles are visible at mid-height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US interior leaf, usually 0.76 m (30 in) or 0.81 m (32 in); a 0.71 m (28 in) closet leaf is possible.

anchors.description: Overall cabinet width of the CRT television between the left and right front bezel edges at mid-screen height
anchors.visible_evidence: Whole front of a 4:3 CRT television on a wooden cart; both vertical bezel edges are clearly visible at mid-height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Screen size and model unknown; a 24-27 in 4:3 CRT cabinet is 0.66-0.79 m wide (32 in sets exist but would be wider than the cart).
